name: smwsprites-moving-boss-fireball-v1
title: Moving Boss Fireball v1.1
description:
This simple sprite is an improvement of vanilla sprite 34, the boss fireball, which is used by Ludwig Von Koopa. It's meant to be placed directly in a level, to spawn with X and Y speeds set in the extra byte.
When the extra bit is set, the fireball will face the player's direction and move towards him accordingly.

Requested by Fernandito2018 during C3 Winter 2025.
